slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell to 7,673.52, down 0.58%, with the Dow dropping 1.18% and health care hit hard. The bigger story is oil, which jumped to $94.06 a barrel after Houthi attacks on Saudi energy sites, reviving fears about inflation and pushing bond yields higher. The VIX, which measures how much fear is priced into the market, rose to 15.72. Friday brings CPI data, which measures how fast consumer prices are rising, and that number could move markets sharply in either direction.
